title: TR3NACRIA & Alexandra Stan - We Are Free

lines.l: We are free, free to live and dream
Free to choose our way, our team
Our future is loud, our path is clear
We are free, free to live and dream
Free to love, to fight, to scream
This world is yours, this world is mine
Oh, she's sweet but a psycho, a little bit psycho
At night she's screaming, I'm on my mind, I'm on my mind
